sentences: Michael Jackson's hair was on fire.
In Los Angeles, he's filming a Pepsi commercial.
The fireworks go off too early.
Sparks land in his slicked-back hair.
He reaches the bottom and spins.
Then the crew tackles him and smothers the flames.
Second and third degree burns on his scalp.
Pepsi settled for one point five million dollars.
He gave all of it away.
To the hospital that treated his burns.
Its burn center was named after him.
